description: Header file for Rocket UI integration in the Unvanquished game, defining classes, functions, and external references related to the Rocket UI system, including event handling, color adaptation, and element registration.

classes.name: RocketEvent_t
classes.description: Represents a UI event in the Rocket system, encapsulating the event, command, target element, and parameters.

classes.name: UnvPropertyId
classes.description: Holds static property identifiers for Rml::PropertyId, such as Orientation.

classes.name: Color::ColorAdaptor
classes.description: Template class for adapting Rml::Colour objects to a uniform interface for color components.

methods.name: CG_EscapeHTMLText
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe HTML display.

methods.name: Rocket_QuakeToRML
methods.description: Converts Quake-style text to RML format.

methods.name: CG_KeyBinding
methods.description: Returns the key binding string for a given command and team.

methods.name: Rocket_AddEvent
methods.description: Adds a RocketEvent_t to the event system.

methods.name: Rocket_SetDocumentScale
methods.description: Sets the scale of a Rocket UI document.

methods.name: CG_AnyMenuOpen
methods.description: Checks if any UI menu is currently open.

methods.name: RegisterElement
methods.description: Template function to register a new UI element type with the Rocket factory.
